about: SDK 3.0.0: a refusal says what to do (make_refusals.py; every message and fix is the catalogue's). Each case is the first answer the Client gets from the API (`status`, the JSON `body`) and the error the call that needed the server raises (`expect`: code, the entry of server_rejected.reasons used or null, message, fix). The refusal's code is the body's `reason` when the catalogue has an entry for it, else its `error`. `app` is the identifier the Client registered with and fills {origin}; `sdk` fills {sdk}. diagnose() then reports the key as not accepted with the expected code as its reason, and lastError is the expected code.

cases.name: a key the server does not know
cases.about: 401 invalid_key with no reason: a made-up or revoked key. As before.

expect.message: Quran Lab does not accept this key.
expect.fix: Copy the key for this app and platform again from sdk.quranlab.ai; a revoked key has to be replaced by a new one there.

cases.name: the key belongs to another app
cases.about: 401 invalid_key with reason app_not_allowed: the key is bound to the first app identifier that used it, and this is another one.

expect.message: This key belongs to another app (app_not_allowed).
expect.fix: A key works for the first app that used it. Make a key for this app at https://sdk.quranlab.ai/keys, or allow this app's identifier on the key's page.

cases.name: the page's origin is not on the key
cases.about: 401 invalid_key with reason origin_not_allowed ({origin} is the identifier the Client registered with).

expect.message: This page's origin, org.example.halaqa, is not on the key (origin_not_allowed).
expect.fix: Add this page's origin (scheme, host and port, for example https://app.example.org) to the key on its page at https://sdk.quranlab.ai/keys.

cases.name: a key of the wrong type

expect.message: This key is of the wrong type for this platform (key_type_mismatch).
expect.fix: Use an apps key on Android and iOS, a desktop key on macOS, Windows and Linux, and a web key in a browser page; sdk.quranlab.ai makes each of them under the same app.

cases.name: a reason this SDK does not know
cases.about: 401 invalid_key with a reason the catalogue has no entry for: as without a reason.

expect.message: Quran Lab does not accept this key.
expect.fix: Copy the key for this app and platform again from sdk.quranlab.ai; a revoked key has to be replaced by a new one there.

cases.name: a null reason
cases.about: 401 invalid_key with reason null: as without a reason.

expect.message: Quran Lab does not accept this key.
expect.fix: Copy the key for this app and platform again from sdk.quranlab.ai; a revoked key has to be replaced by a new one there.

cases.name: a blocked app
cases.about: 403 with the code in `error`, as before.

expect.message: Quran Lab does not serve this app at the moment: it is blocked by Quran Lab or paused by its developer (app_blocked).
expect.fix: Open the app's page on sdk.quranlab.ai: unpause the app there, or read the reason for the block and write to Quran Lab from the account that owns the app.

expect.message: The account behind this key has no access to Quran Lab yet (developer_not_approved).
expect.fix: Open https://sdk.quranlab.ai/start with the account that owns the key and finish the access request; the key works as soon as access is given.

cases.name: a 403 this SDK does not know
cases.about: 403 with a code the catalogue has no entry for: server_rejected with the code as {detail}.

expect.message: Quran Lab refused this app: a_code_from_later.
expect.fix: Check in sdk.quranlab.ai that the key belongs to this app id and platform and that the app is not blocked.

cases.name: the reason is read first
cases.about: A body with both: `reason` names a catalogue entry, so it decides, not `error`.

expect.message: This key is of the wrong type for this platform (key_type_mismatch).
expect.fix: Use an apps key on Android and iOS, a desktop key on macOS, Windows and Linux, and a web key in a browser page; sdk.quranlab.ai makes each of them under the same app.

cases.name: the key needs a newer SDK
cases.about: 403 sdk_too_old keeps its own code; the message names the answer's min_sdk.

body.message: This key needs a newer SDK.

expect.message: This key needs SDK 3.1.0 or later; this is 3.0.0.
expect.fix: Upgrade the TajweedFormer SDK to 3.1.0 or later (the min_sdk of the server's answer), with the install line of the README.
